CE domain/uniqueness and Jensen equivalence; C2 common-interval positive-derivative Arrow–Pratt equivalence in both directions; C3 bounded-shock Taylor remainder and inverse mean-value bound. Strictness and approximation limits explicit.
Full finite FSD summation and indicator converse; increasing-concave SSD hinge characterization, endpoint atoms, all real thresholds and finite knots. Unequal means distinguished from spreads.

Nearest-point finite separation proved. Equal-mean spread converse constructs compact conditional-row marginal set, bounded-slope concave H envelope and contradiction after affine monotonicity correction; constant Y and support endpoints handled.
Finite Bayes with zero-signal convention, value bounds, deterministic optimality, common-optimal-action iff zero value, additive-fee hypothesis and unchanged-action scope.

Row-stochastic simulation sufficiency for all priors/payoffs; full finite converse via nearest-point separator converted into a payoff table. Fixed full-support prior sufficient for all payoffs; explicit zero-prior failure and noncomparable experiments.

Exact log/harmonic certainty equivalents, premiums and both Arrow–Pratt comparison directions with domains.
General uniform remainder and explicit half-risk rationalized positive error bound; no large-risk generalization.
Both FSD directions, all union-support values, strictness and unequal-mean obstruction to a spread.
Complete SSD hinge and conditional-Jensen proofs plus finite coupling converse and sure-3 spread example.
Every CDF/lower-moment knot and both capped-utility witnesses; strictly increasing adjustment preserves ranking.
Bayes/posterior actions/perfect bound, fee boundary and zero-value iff common action with changed payoff case.
Matrix product, complete policy value, reverse inverse with negative entries and exact acquisition boundary.
Full finite converse, separator-to-payoff construction, fixed full-support scope and degenerate-prior witness.
Both binary tasks, classification, posterior energy and repeated-row impossibility in both directions.
Six-dimension 12-point referee rubric: scoped order, actions/prior, utility, costs, empirical limits and a concrete evidence/witness design.

instruction_audit.coverage: All five canonical topics; six complete original cases; twelve prompt/answer pairs; worked definitions before proofs; answered teach-back and delayed retention.
instruction_audit.markup: Flat prerequisite and v13-c04 successor filenames, namespace v13-c03, six article.worked, ol.exercises and grouped details.solutions with exact data-solution-for pairing.
instruction_audit.source_scope: Four inspected primary scopes, three retained PDFs and eight viewed equation images. Börgers text-only access limits and extracted sign inconsistency are explicit; no original Blackwell-paper inspection claim.
instruction_audit.reproduction: Finite learner-facing procedures remain in the manuscript; production numerical checking is described as editorial evidence, without implying an absent reader download. The quiet standard-library checker uses only four runtime files.

numerical_audit: Independent direct/centered moments, log-exp versus squared CE, exact error rationalization, step-CDF integrals, FSD summation, hinge representation, full deterministic decision policies, Bayes plausibility/common-action criterion, reverse kernel, repeated rows and explicit separating payoff witness. Printed calculation anchors bound to reconstructed results.
domain_audit: Bounded vectors/matrices and rational values; booleans/nonfinite/string/complex/oversized numbers, invalid probability rows, mismatched dimensions, unordered or duplicate support and strict-JSON duplicates/constants rejected. No random grid.

validation.final_evidence_delivery: Exact final payload hashes and the three byte-bound execution results accompany the author freeze. This record supplies the audit and runtime contract; it is not a self-referential execution log.
validation.invariance: The final gate harness checks strict JSON API results, empty stdout/stderr, and unchanged exact members and bytes. Source-preparation and blueprint files are excluded from the portable runtime.

limits: Finite universal proofs are audited mathematically; bounded numerical witnesses are not proofs over arbitrary inputs.
No arbitrary measurable experiments, ambiguity/strategic information model or empirical source dataset is included.
Risk-neutral monetary fee subtraction and free randomized garbling require the stated opportunity contract.
Primary PDFs and provenance-only records are not distributed or read by the four-file runtime.
